name: test-pass-two-items
setup_js: () => { const ids = [...new Set([...document.querySelectorAll('button.pick')].map(b => b.dataset.id))].slice(0, 2); const o = {}; ids.forEach((id, i) => { for (const v of ['ok', 'warn', 'na']) o[v + (i + 1)] = 'button.pick[data-id=' + JSON.stringify(id) + '][data-v=' + v + ']'; }); return o; }
